response:
That sounds really hurtful—being repeatedly canceled on and then seeing you were left out would sting anyone. Your feelings are completely valid.

Before you send that group text, it might help to pause. Right now the message would come from anger, and calling them immature could push them further away or turn into a bigger conflict. If you value these friendships, consider reaching out to one person you trust and saying honestly how you felt: "I saw the dinner photo and felt really left out—it's been bothering me." That opens a real conversation instead of a defensive one. And if their pattern of canceling and excluding continues, it's okay to reflect on whether this friendship is giving you what you deserve. Either way, your hurt makes sense, and you're allowed to want to be treated with care.
